reviews.text: Thank you so much !
Thank you so much, Mario! We hope to see you soon!

I had a very bad experience with them. My corgi, who was 8 months old at the time, contracted giardia and coronavirus. Something that worried me a lot was that the dogs drink water from the same bowl, without any apparent proper system in place to separate the sick ones. If even one dog has giardia, there's a risk that others will become infected by sharing the same bowl.

Furthermore, I didn't like the way they transport the dogs: they take them in vans, enclosed in crates or carriers along with two or three other dogs. I believe that, in addition to the stress this can cause, it also makes it difficult to keep track of any sick dogs.

I mainly took him there for obedience and command training. From the time he was two months old, I always made sure to socialize him: I took him with me to different places, he interacted with other dogs, and he was very friendly. However, after taking him out of there because he got sick, his behavior changed drastically, and he became reactive with other dogs.

I can't say for sure what happened while he was there because I was never informed of any incidents, but the change in his behavior was very noticeable. He even bit the trainer, something he had never done before, and it hasn't happened again since. The only thing that remained was his reactivity towards other dogs, something he didn't exhibit before going there.

Terrible, I don't recommend them. Today they returned my dog ​​to me wet on his chest and front paws. I asked what had happened and they told me it had rained where he was, but how could that be if the place is enclosed? Then I found out they had taken him to Toluca without my consent, and it wasn't rain, it was drool because he was dizzy! And yesterday they returned him covered in pee. What a lack of ethics! 😡
Great place for dog boarding and daycare. They are very careful with the dogs and they receive vet checkups.
They don't take proper care of the puppies and they mistreat them; the caretakers hit the animals.

Without fear of disagreement, I dare say it's one of the best services in the city. They're not the only ones, but they are the best.
Quality service and excellent facilities.

But above all, honesty.
Without a doubt, a highly recommended service for responsible owners who truly want a real change for their pet.
Casa Pek is the best daycare for your pet, with the best trainers in Mexico.

Terrible! They completely lie to you. The dogs are locked up all day, probably in cages, because they handed my dog ​​back to me covered in pee and wet, and he never urinates like that unless he wasn't allowed outside. They also lie about taking them for walks, but my dog's AirTag never left the premises. STOP MAKING LIARS RICH!
5 stars for ease, affordability, great location and kind employees…rooftop location but also across from Park España…convenient long hours… we have been here a week and already used them 3 times

THEY WANT TO WASH THEIR GUARDS IF THEY KILL YOUR DOG

The whole thing is terrible. I took my dog ​​to their doggy daycare a few months ago, and they sent her back "because the vet said she was sick or recovering from an illness." For context, she hadn't been sick at that time, nor recently, and they NEVER told me they were going to do their fabricated check-up to be able to admit her (but they're quick to collect payment upfront).

Since they "released" her, I thought, okay, I'll try it for a month. Then, when I asked to review the contract, it literally states that they could practically kill your dog and disclaim responsibility. So I requested a review and to speak with their legal department because this is clearly unacceptable, and to determine if they should be held responsible when it's due to fault or negligence, since they CLEARLY should be responsible for this because we're paying for their care. They've been stalling since May 26th (it's now October). Obviously, they're not going to give me an answer, but it's absurd. Be careful with your dogs because even if you kill them, they won't answer for you.
I wasn't thrilled; I think they have room for improvement in their staffing.

This month, my dog ​​turns one year old at this doggy daycare, and it's been the best experience. It's a place where they play, socialize, train, and above all, are very well cared for. Every morning when they come to pick her up, she runs to jump in the van. Definitely highly recommended!
Great items for your dog :)
I didn't like it at all
They're always available, and my dog ​​is very happy when he stays with them. Although the price is high, it's worth it to have my dog ​​safe and sound.
It's the only place I would leave my dogs; they are the most professional and reliable, and the facilities are 10/10. The only downside is that they don't have a route in Coyoacan 😞 …

Excellent place to leave your dogs with peace of mind. They have great trainers who always strive for the best performance and activities for your dogs. We've entrusted our dogs to them for several years now, and they've always been known for their professionalism and excellent customer service. Highly recommended.

We've had a fantastic experience at Pek and Pek University. Odin finished his training here a few months ago, and we've stayed for several reasons. First, it's clear the staff enjoys their work and understands dog behavior well. Second, there's excellent communication, from the initial transfer to the length of his stay.

And lastly, Odin is so happy to be running free (we live in a small apartment) and comes home exhausted every afternoon, proof that he gets plenty of exercise and has a great time.
Finally, I consider myself demanding when I pay for a service; I expect to receive what I pay for, and they've definitely exceeded all expectations. The facilities have been improving, and we've only been bringing our dog here for less than a year. A huge thank you to all the coaches at Pek University. I hope our relationship with Odin continues for many years; they certainly brighten his life.

(Attached is evidence of how exhausted he is after his mornings at Pek University)

They're excellent with dogs; they love them, guide them, and help them manage their emotions, all in a comfortable, clean, safe, and spacious environment.
At University, they have ample space, and you can choose from daycare to training as an owner to become a better guardian for your furry friend.

Thanks, Jean!
Excellent service! Arya loves every run she goes.

Excellent! It's truly a place designed for pets, not owners. They have all the services: a veterinary clinic, grooming, daycare, training, social activities, talks, boarding, toys, parties, cakes, gifts, beds, organic disinfectants, ALL KONGS, eco-friendly toothpaste, etc. And LOTS OF LOVE 💕🐶🐾 …
Thank you!!!!

Unfortunately, this kennel has lost its focus on animal welfare and has become more of a business than a responsible care facility. The number of dogs is so high that they lack the capacity to provide individualized attention. I don't doubt the team's good intentions or knowledge, but it's clear they need more staff to ensure the dogs' safety.

My dog, who is playful, gentle, and very sociable, returned injured and visibly frightened. He's a large dog with a beta temperament, which, without proper supervision, can easily be harassed by more aggressive or alpha dogs. He came back with a wound on his paw, swelling on his front legs, and a stomach infection. Most worryingly, he was examined by the kennel's own veterinarian, who assured me he was perfectly healthy, and that's why they released him to me in that condition.

I hope they can review their supervision and medical care protocols. The concept is good, but in its current state, they are not guaranteeing the well-being or safety of the animals entrusted to them.

It's THE BEST place! My Benito is the happiest every day when he goes to Pek University! I was looking for a place where they were loving with the dogs and I couldn't have found a better place! Thank you, thank you all for taking care of my baby and making him so happy! Especially to Mr. Hugo who treats him like his own! Don't hesitate to bring your dogs here! You won't regret it! 🫶🏻🐶

Terrible service at the front desk. It sounds great on WhatsApp when they give you information about the training, and they told me to come to this location for my dog's evaluation and to sign a contract to start her classes. When I arrived, a very rude woman told me I had to come back another day because they had no record of the appointment I had already made. She told me that if I wanted to ask specific questions, I would have to pay $850 for the evaluation, which I don't mind, but even though I said I did want the evaluation, she said no, it wasn't possible that day.

I don't doubt the trainer's abilities, and we even had the money ready to pay for the course, but with that kind of treatment, I'm even less inclined to leave my dogs there.

Honestly, they are the BEST. They are 100% worth the price. They are all SUPER professional and have extensive canine knowledge (and are also very kind). They love and care for our dogs with professionalism and lots of love. Plus, the facilities are excellent and they have a veterinarian on staff. 🙌 They are the BEST. I trust them 100% 💜
It's not just a daycare, it's a canine school and university 😎 The Best! …
Thank you so much for trusting us!

Terrible place. I left my three giants at the daycare so they could run around and not be confined, but they kept them in kennels and returned all three of them sick...
I've been taking Lucca there for three years now, and I'm more than satisfied. It's a place where they take excellent care of the dogs. Highly recommended.

This is not a good place to leave your dogs. They bark constantly, day and night, and no one there does anything to calm them down. It's not the right facility for them.
I don't think the facilities are suitable for keeping dogs overnight. I always hear them barking as if they're being neglected.

Terrible service, they don't take good care of the dogs. They never resolve your problems and treat you like they don't need their clients. Honestly, of all the dog services, this is the WORST company! The first day they took our dog, he arrived with two wounds on his ear, and they didn't even tell us about it!

DON'T RISK YOUR DOG BY LEAVING HIM IN THE HANDS OF SUCH IGNORANT AND UNPROFESSIONAL PEOPLE!
I have two dogs, and they both love going to Casa Pek urban daycare on weekends when my husband and I have plans we can't take them to; but what they love most is Pek University!!! Highly recommended

I was a little apprehensive because of some reviews, but it turned out to be an amazing option for my little one, "Bacardi." Everyone is so kind and transparent, and she came back exhausted after just a few days with them.
It's truly an excellent recommendation. I'll definitely be back! 😊 …
